record.rationale: Task V4DQJW page-frame prerequisite replaces the geometry-only SwPageDesc state with four document-pool-owned SwFrameFormat owners, native usage flags, registered-name uniqueness and copy/follow behavior. SwTextGridItem retains native eleven-field defaults, typed UNO members and paper-mode arithmetic; page UNO properties use actual pooled items. Browser graph records retain all four direct item sets, independent frame names and optional native user grid defaults; legacy geometry ingress remains explicit. Consumed ItemInfoStatic/User metadata now serves registered pool defaults without inventing contiguous ranges. Complete frame-size codec is shared with tables; LR browser transport copies original raw scalar fields including propLeft/propRight through explicit host field access, avoiding proportional setter rescaling. This host serialization binding is local infrastructure, not native semantic certification. SectionPropertyMap/default-page-mode/document/style loading, DOCX export/Open/download and ODT grid serialization remain pending. Existing statuses and intentional recovery/autosave/file UI deviations are preserved.
